    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">(CDH 7.3)Cloudera CDP Private Cloud Base 7.3.2 VS Acceldata ODP 3.3.6.4 对比</span>
    

</a>

        </div>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><strong>Acceldata ODP 3.3.6.4 vs Cloudera CDP Private Cloud Base 7.3.2 <span style="font-family: 宋体">对比</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">说明：</span>CDP7.3.2 <span style="font-family: 宋体">是 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">私有云基座版本，</span><strong>Cloudera Manager <span style="font-family: 宋体">管理</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">；</span>ODP3.3.6.4 <span style="font-family: 宋体">基于</span><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">原生</span> Ambari</strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">，</span>Apache <span style="font-family: 宋体">上游原生组件，无闭源私有分支。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">一、核心组件版本对比表</span></strong></p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="3">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">组件</span></strong></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><strong>ODP 3.3.6.4</strong></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><strong>CDP 7.3.2</strong></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">简要差异说明</span></strong></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">平台管理工具</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>Ambari<span style="font-family: 宋体">（原生 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">MPack</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>Cloudera Manager<span style="font-family: 宋体">（</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CM</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">自研）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>ODP<span style="font-family: 宋体">：</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Ambari </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">开源；</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CDP</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">：</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CM </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">闭源，需要订阅授权才能使用完整功能</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>Hadoop(HDFS/YARN/MR2)</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>3.3.6</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>3.4.0</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>CDP Hadoop <span style="font-family: 宋体">基于上游做大量 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">私有补丁；</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">ODP </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">是 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Apache </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">原版 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">3.3.6</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，支持多 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Standby NN</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>Spark</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>4.1.1<span style="font-family: 宋体">（可选 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">3.3.3/3.5.1/3.5.5 </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">多版本共存）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>3.5.0</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>✅ODP <span style="font-family: 宋体">优势：</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark4</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark Connect </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">远程架构、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Gluten+Velox </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">向量化加速；</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CDP </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">最高 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark3.5</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，无 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark4</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>Hive</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>4.0.1</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>Hive3<span style="font-family: 宋体">（</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">定制分支）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>ODP Hive4 <span style="font-family: 宋体">原生 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Iceberg/Hudi/Delta</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">；</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CDP Hive3 </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">带 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera Lakehouse </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">优化器，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Iceberg </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">为 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">增强版本</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>Celeborn <span style="font-family: 宋体">远程 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Shuffle</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>0.6.2<span style="font-family: 宋体">（原生支持）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>❌<span style="font-family: 宋体">无内置，需要自行部署</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>✅ODP <span style="font-family: 宋体">独有内置 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">RSS</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，解决 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">大规模 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Shuffle </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">磁盘瓶颈</span></p>

</td>

<p>3.6.1<span style="font-family: 宋体">，支持 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Tiered </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">分层存储</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>3.9.0<span style="font-family: 宋体">，带 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera SRM </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">流复制</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>CDP Kafka <span style="font-family: 宋体">版本更高；</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">ODP </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">内置 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Kafka </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">分层存储，冷数据下沉对象存储</span></p>

<p>Ozone</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>2.1.0</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>Ozone<span style="font-family: 宋体">（</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">定制版）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>CDP Ozone <span style="font-family: 宋体">内置 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">EC </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">纠删码；</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">ODP </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">原生 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Apache Ozone</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">S3A </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">协议兼容</span></p>

</tr>

<td valign="center">
<p>NiFi</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>2.7.2<span style="font-family: 宋体">（可选 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">1.x</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>CFM<span style="font-family: 宋体">（</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera Flow Manager</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，基于 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">NiFi </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的商业发行版）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>ODP <span style="font-family: 宋体">原生 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Apache NiFi</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">；</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CDP </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CFM </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">是 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">打包商业版，需要订阅</span></p>

</tr>

<p>Apache Superset 6.0<span style="font-family: 宋体">（原生集成 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Ambari</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>Hue<span style="font-family: 宋体">（</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">定制）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>ODP <span style="font-family: 宋体">自带 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Superset </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">现代 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">BI</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">；</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CDP </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">使用 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Hue</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，无原生 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Superset</span></p>
</td>
</tr>

</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>43x <span style="font-family: 宋体">系列（原生 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">MPack</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">可添加，非原生预装</span></p>
</td>

<p><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">二、平台基础能力对比</span></strong></p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="3">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">对比项</span></strong></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><strong>ODP 3.3.6.4</strong></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><strong>CDP 7.3.2</strong></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">底层组件来源</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><strong>Apache <span style="font-family: 宋体">上游原生，无私有 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">fork </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">分支</span></strong></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">基于</span> Apache <span style="font-family: 宋体">社区，大量 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">私有补丁、私有扩展，部分 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">API </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">被锁定</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">许可模式</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">平台本身</span><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">免费无</span> License <span style="font-family: 宋体">费用</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">；企业支持按需采购</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">强制订阅制</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">，不购买订阅，</span>CM <span style="font-family: 宋体">高级功能、补丁、技术支持不可用，存在厂商锁定</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">推荐操作系统</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>RHEL9<span style="font-family: 宋体">，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">JDK17 + Python3</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>RHEL9.6<span style="font-family: 宋体">，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">JDK17</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">；</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CDP7.3.2 </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">对旧 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">RHEL8 </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">兼容逐步降级</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">部署管理器</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>Ambari <span style="font-family: 宋体">开源，可离线 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">RPM </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">部署，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">VDF </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">版本管理</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>Cloudera Manager <span style="font-family: 宋体">闭源，离线部署依赖 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">官方 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">parcel </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">包</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">多</span> Spark <span style="font-family: 宋体">版本共存</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>✅<span style="font-family: 宋体">支持</span> Spark3.x <span style="font-family: 宋体">与 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark4 </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">并行部署，业务灰度迁移</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">仅</span> Spark3.5<span style="font-family: 宋体">，不支持 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark4</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">；无法原生多 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">版本并行</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">湖仓表格式</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">原生</span> Iceberg/Hudi/Delta Lake <span style="font-family: 宋体">三大开放格式</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>Iceberg <span style="font-family: 宋体">深度增强（</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera Lakehouse Optimizer</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">），</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Hudi/Delta </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">支持较弱</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">远程</span> Shuffle<span style="font-family: 宋体">（</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Celeborn</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>✅<span style="font-family: 宋体">内置原生支持</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>❌<span style="font-family: 宋体">无内置，需手动部署、集成，无</span> CM <span style="font-family: 宋体">管理 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">MPack</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>AI/ML <span style="font-family: 宋体">生态</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">原生集成</span> MLflow<span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">JupyterHub</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，支持 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Ray/PyTorch/TensorFlow</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">支持</span> ML<span style="font-family: 宋体">，但 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">AI </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">生态需要额外部署，无原生 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">MLflow </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">集成</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">可观测性</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>Ambari <span style="font-family: 宋体">基础监控；可选 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Acceldata Pulse </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">增值平台</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>CM <span style="font-family: 宋体">内置监控、告警、诊断工具；高级监控需要额外付费模块</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">高可用覆盖</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">多</span> Standby NN<span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Trino Coordinator HA</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">NiFi Registry HA</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>HDFS HA<span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Kafka SRM HA</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，组件 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">HA </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">能力成熟，但为 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">私有方案</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">升级方式</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">自主可控，可在线</span> / <span style="font-family: 宋体">离线升级，自主掌握 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">RPM </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">包</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">依赖</span> Cloudera <span style="font-family: 宋体">官方 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Parcel </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">包，版本升级、补丁交付由厂商控制</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>TCO</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">软件许可成本低；仅按需购买原厂支持</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">订阅费用高，集群规模越大，年度订阅成本越高</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">厂商锁定</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">无锁定，</span>RPM <span style="font-family: 宋体">包完全可控，可自行维护</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">强厂商锁定；私有补丁、</span>Parcel <span style="font-family: 宋体">包、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CM </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">绑定 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">订阅</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">三、优势总结</span></strong></p>
<p><strong>ODP 3.3.6.4 <span style="font-family: 宋体">对比 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CDP7.3.2 </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的优势</span></strong></p>
<p>1. <strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">无厂商锁定，零平台许可费</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">：全部</span> Apache <span style="font-family: 宋体">原生代码，没有 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">订阅锁；企业可以自主维护 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">RPM </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">包，降低长期 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">TCO</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">。</span></p>
<p>2. <strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">更新技术栈</span> Spark4+Hive4</strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">：</span>CDP7.3.2 <span style="font-family: 宋体">最高 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark3.5</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">ODP </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">直接上 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark4</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，支持 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark Connect </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">远程开发，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Gluten </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">向量化加速，适合新一代湖仓业务。</span></p>
<p>3. <strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">内置</span> Celeborn <span style="font-family: 宋体">远程 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Shuffle</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">：大规模离线</span> / <span style="font-family: 宋体">流式 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">SQL </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">任务，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Shuffle </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">压力大幅降低，减少磁盘瓶颈，提升大任务稳定性。</span></p>
<p>4. <strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">三大湖仓格式原生支持</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">：</span>Iceberg/Hudi/Delta <span style="font-family: 宋体">同时支持，跨引擎统一读写，湖仓方案更灵活。</span></p>
<p>5. <strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">多</span> Spark <span style="font-family: 宋体">版本并行运行</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">：存量旧业务继续跑</span> Spark3<span style="font-family: 宋体">，新业务上 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark4</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，</span><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">灰度平滑迁移，不需要一次性割接</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">，非常适合</span> CDP <span style="font-family: 宋体">迁移场景。</span></p>
<p>6. <strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">原生自带</span> Superset<span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Trino</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Pinot</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">，开箱即用</span> BI <span style="font-family: 宋体">与实时 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">OLAP</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CDP </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">需要额外安装。</span></p>
<p><strong>CDP7.3.2 <span style="font-family: 宋体">对比 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">ODP 3.3.6.4 </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的优势</span></strong></p>
<p>1. <strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">商业产品成熟度更高</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">：</span>CM <span style="font-family: 宋体">管理平台稳定，多年企业落地沉淀；</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Ranger</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Atlas</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Iceberg </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">有大量 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">自研增强，企业安全治理能力更强。</span></p>
<p>2. <strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">内置</span> Cloudera Lakehouse Optimizer</strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">，</span>Iceberg <span style="font-family: 宋体">查询性能优化突出，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Iceberg </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">场景下查询性能优势明显。</span></p>
<p>3. <strong>Kafka SRM <span style="font-family: 宋体">流复制、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Ozone </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">纠删码等增强组件</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">，流平台、对象存储企业级特性更完善。</span></p>
<p>4. <strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">原厂端到端</span> SLA <span style="font-family: 宋体">支持</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">，全套商业支持、故障诊断、官方补丁，适合核心金融、政企强</span> SLA <span style="font-family: 宋体">业务。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">四、适用选型建议</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>· ✅ <strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">优先选</span> ODP3.3.6.4</strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">：</span> <span style="font-family: 宋体">现有</span> CDP/HDP <span style="font-family: 宋体">集群降本迁移、想摆脱厂商订阅锁定；需要 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark4</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Celeborn</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">；业务分阶段灰度迁移；预算有限，希望自主掌握平台软件包。</span></li>
<li>· ✅ <strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">优先选</span> CDP7.3.2</strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">：</span> <span style="font-family: 宋体">核心交易级强</span> SLA <span style="font-family: 宋体">业务，依赖 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">商业增强特性（</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Lakehouse </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">优化器、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">SRM</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">）；团队熟悉 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Cloudera Manager</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，愿意持续支付订阅费用。</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">五、迁移提示</span></strong></p>
<p>CDP <span style="font-family: 宋体">迁移 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">ODP</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">：</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Hive SQL</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Spark </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">任务兼容性很高；但 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CDP </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的</span><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">私有扩展、</span>Cloudera <span style="font-family: 宋体">专属 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Iceberg </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">增强、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CFM </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">流管理</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">需要改造。</span>HDFS/YARN <span style="font-family: 宋体">底层存储和调度模型一致，数据层可以复用，业务可以逐步迁移。</span></p>

</div>
